text: 国际经济关系司2026年11月13日下午邀请英国《金融时报》副主编兼首席经济评论员马丁·沃尔夫就全球宏观经济形势作线上专题讲座，财政部副部长廖岷出席并主持。（财联社）
text_en: On the afternoon of November 13, 2026, the Department of International Economic Relations invited Martin Wolf, deputy editor and chief economics commentator of the Financial Times, to give an online special lecture on the global macroeconomic situation. Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min attended and presided over the event. (Cailian Press)
